title: Publication Receipt
description: Traceability record linking an editorial plan to what the CMS actually published, per prompt-evolucao-subsistema-editorial.md §18. The CMS remains the canonical source of the content itself - this is a pointer plus enough metadata for feedback/outcomes, not a copy of the article. Stub contract: no real integration exists yet (Fase F / CMS work item 2026-08-04 is blocked), so no code writes this format automatically today.

publication_id.description: Stable identifier for this publication event, PUB-YYYY-NNN.

publication_request_id.description: Reference to the originating Publication Package (prompt §17), when one exists. Null for content published without an external request (the common case today).

editorial_plan_id.description: The editorial plan this receipt closes the loop on.

platform_content_id.description: The CMS's own internal ID for the published content. Opaque to this repo - never re-derived or guessed.

environment.description: Which environment actually served the publish. A receipt from a non-production environment is real but must never be mistaken for a live publication.

verification_source.description: How this receipt was confirmed against the CMS (e.g. 'cms-api', 'manual-check-2026-08-14'). A receipt without a verification source is a claim, not a fact - this field exists so the record always says how it knows what it knows.
